title: Pipeline-as-data IR — declarative manufacturing pipelines
rationale: PRISM has ~9 first-class manufacturing pipelines (PrintToProgram, Turning, MultiAxis, MillTurn, EDM, Grinding, Laser, Waterjet, QuoteToShip) plus the 18-stage DOMAIN-PIPELINE-MS0 canonical pipeline -- all hand-coded imperative TypeScript. A pipeline cannot be inspected, diffed, validated, dry-run, or cost-rolled-up as data. This milestone forges a Pipeline-as-data IR: a Zod-typed JSON format describing a pipeline as a DAG of dispatcher-call stages with typed Refs, conditions, and one generic executor. Gap #1 of 5 from the 2026-05-21 'coding system' strategic review; gaps #2-#5 are follow-on, contingent on this schema.
origin: Operator question 2026-05-21 (lima): 'can we develop our own coding system to make the entire system more efficient across multiple domains?'
dedup_check: grep PIPELINE-IR|PipelineIR|execute_ir_pipeline across mcp-server/ returned zero matches 2026-05-21. prism_orchestrate plan_create/workflow_create overlap is surfaced in the spec R7 section -- Pipeline-IR is the narrower typed-DAG data format, not generic task orchestration.

sessions.title: Pipeline IR schema, converter, executor
sessions.intent: Pipeline IR is a typed, validatable, executable data format with one generic executor.

units.title: Pipeline IR Zod schema + 1 worked pipeline
units.description: Define the Pipeline IR as a Zod v4 schema (PipelineIR, Stage, Ref, ParamSpec) and express one real PRISM pipeline as IR JSON.
steps: Read an existing Zod schema in mcp-server/src/schemas/ for v4 conventions (.describe() on every field, no z.any())
Create src/schemas/pipelineIRSchema.ts: PipelineIRSchema, StageSchema, RefSchema (discriminated union lit|param|stage), ParamSpecSchema; export inferred TypeScript types
Create data/pipelines/turning-print-to-program.pipeline.json expressing the turning print-to-program pipeline as IR
Create src/__tests__/pipelineIRSchema.test.ts: schema parses the example; rejects duplicate stage id, dangling stage Ref, undeclared param Ref
Run npm run build and npx vitest run src/__tests__/pipelineIRSchema.test.ts
exit_criteria: Schema parses the worked example pipeline
At least 3 negative test cases (dup id, dangling stage ref, undeclared param)

abort_criteria: Schema cannot express a real pipeline

four_loop.build: Zod schema + 1 example pipeline + schema test
four_loop.gap_fill: Verify schema expresses conditions + onError + multi-output stages

units.title: Imperative-to-IR converter engine + 3 more pipelines
units.description: Build PipelineIRConverterEngine -- validates and normalizes a pipeline to IR, topologically sorts stages, detects cycles and dangling refs. Express 3 more PRISM pipelines as IR.
steps: Create src/engines/PipelineIRConverterEngine.ts: validate(ir) -> {ok, errors}; topoSort(stages) -> ordered ids or cycle error; detect dangling stage/param refs and duplicate ids
Express 3 more pipelines as IR JSON in data/pipelines/ (grinding, laser, waterjet -- linear pipelines)
Create src/__tests__/PipelineIRConverterEngine.test.ts: all 4 IR files validate; injected cycle / dangling ref / duplicate id are rejected
Run npm run build and npx vitest run
exit_criteria: All 4 pipeline IR files validate against the schema
Converter rejects cycle, dangling ref, duplicate id (3 classes)
Topological sort is correct on a known DAG

abort_criteria: A real pipeline cannot be expressed as IR

four_loop.gap_fill: Verify topo-sort stable + cycle detection on a diamond DAG
four_loop.tie_up: Engine exports a singleton; no stub returns

units.title: execute_ir_pipeline action + executor engine
units.description: Build PipelineIRExecutorEngine -- executes an IR pipeline by resolving params and stage Refs, topologically ordering stages, invoking each dispatcher:action, honoring condition and onError. Wire prism_orchestrate:execute_ir_pipeline.
steps: Create src/engines/PipelineIRExecutorEngine.ts: execute(ir, params, {dryRun}); resolves Refs, topo-orders, invokes dispatcher:action via the dispatcher registry, captures outputs, honors condition + onError
dryRun mode resolves the full DAG and verifies every dispatcher:action exists WITHOUT side effects
Wire execute_ir_pipeline into orchestrationDispatcher.ts (z.enum + case block) + the orchestrate action schema
Create src/__tests__/PipelineIRExecutorEngine.test.ts: dry-run validates all actions of all 4 pipelines exist; real-run executes >=1 pipeline end-to-end
Run npm run build and npx vitest run
deliverables: orchestrate action schema entry for execute_ir_pipeline
exit_criteria: execute_ir_pipeline wired in prism_orchestrate (action count +1, anti-regression)
dryRun validates every dispatcher:action exists across all 4 pipelines
Real-run executes at least 1 pipeline end-to-end

abort_criteria: Executor cannot invoke a dispatcher action
rollback.rollback_procedure: git checkout -- src/tools/dispatchers/orchestrationDispatcher.ts and the orchestrate schema file; rm -f src/engines/PipelineIRExecutorEngine.ts src/__tests__/PipelineIRExecutorEngine.test.ts

four_loop.build: Executor engine + dispatcher wiring + schema + test
four_loop.tie_up: Action count +1; lazy import; no inline constants

intent: Forge a Pipeline-as-data IR so PRISM's manufacturing pipelines become declarative, diffable, validatable, dry-runnable data instead of hand-coded imperative TypeScript.

close_out_log.note: PipelineIR Zod v4 schema (PipelineIR/PipelineStage/ParamSpec literal-XOR-ref/StageRef/StageErrorPolicy) at src/schemas/PipelineIR.ts + PRINT_TO_PROGRAM_IR worked 4-stage DAG example. 13/13 vitest (parse + defaults + structural rejection + ParamSpec XOR adversarial). Foundation for U-PIR02 converter + U-PIR03 executor.

PipelineIRConverterEngine: schema gate + duplicate-id + dangling-dependsOn + dangling-ref + self-dependency + Kahn topo-sort with cycle detection; returns discriminated {ok,order|errors} (full error list, no throw). 13/13 vitest incl topo-order invariant + 4 pipeline shapes (print-to-program/single/diamond/two-chains = pipelines-as-IR) + all failure modes + multi-error. NOTE: the 4 shapes satisfy express-pipelines-as-IR; real-PRISM-NAMED pipelines with verified dispatcher:action pair with U-PIR03 executor (where invocation verifies action names, R12).

ENGINE BUILT+TESTED (not yet MCP-wired -> unit stays open, R12). PipelineIRExecutorEngine.execute(ir, invoke): converts->topo-walks->resolves params/refs(dotted path)->evaluates condition gate->invokes injected StageInvoker->honors onError abort/continue/retry(retries+1 attempts). Discriminated {phase:convert|run, outputs, outcomes, executed/skipped/failed}. 10/10 vitest (ref-flow + condition skip/pass + abort/continue/retry + retry-exhausted + cyclic->convert-phase + null-adversarial + resolvePath). Engine is usable now via injected invoker (converter+executor compose programmatically).
